description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maligathenna, Kandy Four Gravets & Gangawata Korale D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320290
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Nos. 282, 300, 69, and 99) with detailed information about land ownership, extent, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content falls under the "Land and property-related matters" category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
